det.korean: 그녀가 다시 전화로 돌아와 소리쳤다
det.analysis: 주어(she) + came back + 전치사구(on the line) + and + shouted.
det.tip: come back on the line = 다시 전화로 돌아오다

questions.wa: she came back on the line and shouted
accept: she came back on the line and shouted

questions.passage: On my first day in the Emergency Center, I was about to drink my coffee when the first call came. I quickly picked up the line, “9-1-1.” My voice was trembling and my heart was racing. A woman cried, “My husband’s not breathing!” I instructed her to begin CPR. I was trying to be as steady as I could, but I was shaking. The situation was absolutely critical. While she was performing CPR, __________. After a few tense moments, she came back on the line and shouted, “Where’s the ambulance?” I replied, “It’s getting there as quickly as it can.”
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 조건에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.

While she was performing CPR, __________.
(나는 즉시 근처 병원에 알렸다.)

[조건] (1) hospital, I, immediately, nearby, notified, the를 모두 사용할 것
       (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 나는 즉시 근처 병원에 알렸다 → I immediately notified the nearby hospital (6단어)
det.analysis: 주어(I) + 부사(immediately) + 동사(notified) + 목적어(the nearby hospital).
det.tip: I(1) immediately(2) notified(3) the(4) nearby(5) hospital(6)

questions.wa: I immediately notified the nearby hospital
accept: I immediately notified the nearby hospital
